subject: Visibility add-ons — flexible credits, trace retention, and SLA options
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visibility add-ons — retention options & pricing

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are sizing two specific add-ons for our pilot and need a ballpark to take back to procurement:

- Trace retention: we want to retain distributed traces for 90 days (current ask), with full span payloads for three services.
- Advanced dashboards: 6 power users, around 50 saved queries and 10 scheduled reports.

I attached our month-by-month ingestion forecast to help with sizing (acme_usage_forecast.csv).

Two commercial notes from our side: is there a way to roll unused observability credits between quarters, and do you have an SLA for trace ingestion latency (we need ingestion visible within 24 hours)?

Can you provide a two-line commercial option (month-to-month vs 12-month commit) plus any discount thresholds? Procurement will want guidance this week.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Observability & Platform
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention options & pricing

Hi Oliver,

Appreciate the clear asks and the usage file — very helpful. High level options we can propose today (ballpark pricing):

1) Retention tiers (trace storage, price per effective GB/month):
   - 30 days: $0.55/GB
   - 90 days: $1.20/GB
   - 365 days: $2.75/GB

2) Advanced dashboards (seat-based):
   - 1-5 seats: $120/seat/month
   - 6-25 seats: $95/seat/month (volume break at 6 seats)
   - Unlimited saved queries for dashboard bundle; scheduled reports capped at 20 for the 6-seat bundle.

3) Credits and commitments:
   - Month-to-month: list price above, no rollover.
   - 12-month commitment: 12% list discount applied to observability add-ons.
   - Rollover: we support a limited quarterly rollover option on committed plans; terms and caps vary by commit level.

We can do a targeted commercial concession for a strategic customer. I put together a starter worksheet with the numbers and a sample SOW (pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx). If you want to pursue a 12-month commit, we can tighten the numbers and propose a capped rollover provision.

If helpful, I can join procurement on a call tomorrow to walk through the workbook. What days/times work?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 13:32:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Visibility add-ons — retention options & pricing

Team,

Looping you in. Acme wants 90-day trace retention plus 6 seats for advanced dashboards. Marissa proposed the standard 12% commit discount. Procurement will push for rollover credits and faster trace ingestion SLA.

Specific ask from Acme:
- 90-day retention priced per GB (Marissa listed $1.20/GB).
- 6 seats for advanced dashboards, with saved query/scheduled report expectations.
- Rollover of unused observability credits between quarters (they asked for this explicitly).
- SLA: ingestion visible within 24 hours.

Commercial request: Oliver asked if we can do a stronger concession to close this quarter. He said if we can offer an enterprise-friendly rollover and a deeper discount he can move procurement quickly.

Options I'm considering before I respond to procurement:
A) Offer 15% discount on add-ons for a 12-month commit with rollover limited to 2 quarters and capped at 30% of monthly committed spend.
B) Keep at 12% discount but include a 60-day rollover with tighter caps (25%).

Neha: can you confirm margin impact for A vs B and whether 15% is acceptable?
Rishi: any operational concerns with 24-hour trace ingestion SLA and the rollover behavior described?

Mark this internal — please reply with quick yes/no and any redlines.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Visibility add-ons — retention options & pricing

Eve/Marissa — quick margin check. Using the workbook assumptions (see pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx), here are the observations:

- 12% discount on a 12-month commit keeps contribution margin in target band for expected ingestion volumes.
- 15% would push contribution margin near the low end but still within acceptable range if we secure a minimum annual committed spend of $120k for observability add-ons.
- Rollover cap recommendation: allow rollover up to 25% of monthly committed spend and permit carry across two quarters (i.e., up to two quarter rollovers) rather than an open-ended rollover. That reduces revenue leakage and keeps procurement happy.

Operational ask: require a minimum committed spend threshold for the 15% option. If they cannot meet the $120k commit, we should default to option B (12% + 60-day rollover capped at 25%).

Rishi, tagging you for SLA signoff on the ingestion window.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Ops Manager
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Visibility add-ons — proposal and next steps

Oliver,

Thanks for the patience while we worked this internally. Here is what we can offer to close quickly:

- 90-day trace retention at $1.20/GB with a 13% discount off list for observability add-ons on a 12-month committed plan.
- Advanced dashboards: 6 seats at $95/seat/month (volume break applied).
- Rollover: allow unused observability credits to roll across up to two quarters, capped at 25% of the monthly committed spend.
- SLA: we will commit to trace ingestion being visible in the UI within 24 hours for traces under typical ingestion profiles; we will include a definition of typical ingestion profiles in the SOW.

Attached: SOW-draft.pdf and a finalized pricing tab in pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx. If that is acceptable to Acme, next steps are:
1) Sign SOW and commitment (DocuSign link to follow).
2) Kickoff call with our onboarding team to review trace retention config and dashboard templates.

If you need the 15% level, we can do that but it requires a minimum annual commit of $120k for the observability add-ons; happy to discuss.

Would you like me to schedule a short call tomorrow to run through the SOW?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
